stops.name: St. Moritz
stops.quote: For the illustrious White Turf horse racing event, the frozen Lake St. Moritz is transformed into a racecourse in winter.
stops.english: For the illustrious White Turf horse racing event, the frozen Lake St. Moritz is transformed into a racecourse in winter.

stops.name: Chesa Veglia
stops.quote: On a short foray through the illustrious town, discover the Chesa Veglia, one of the Engadin’s oldest farmhouses.
stops.english: On a short foray through the illustrious town, discover the Chesa Veglia, one of the Engadin’s oldest farmhouses.

stops.name: Muottas Muragl
stops.quote: You can enjoy a spectacular view of the Engadin from popular excursion mountain Muottas Muragl.
stops.english: You can enjoy a spectacular view of the Engadin from popular excursion mountain Muottas Muragl.

stops.name: Pontresina
stops.quote: Local products such as wooden sculptures, honey or dried meat can be found in Pontresina or Silvaplana.
stops.english: Local products such as wooden sculptures, honey or dried meat can be found in Pontresina or Silvaplana.

stops.name: Diavolezza Cable Car
stops.quote: Diavolezza Cable Car 4,000m peaks and glaciers
stops.english: Diavolezza Cable Car 4,000m peaks and glaciers

stops.name: Lake Silvaplana
stops.quote: When the Maloja wind blows, windsurfing and kitesurfing fans can be seen having fun on Lake Silvaplana.
stops.english: When the Maloja wind blows, windsurfing and kitesurfing fans can be seen having fun on Lake Silvaplana.

stops.name: Lake Sils
stops.quote: Where the “Segl-Maria” sails across Lake Sils in the warmer months, anglers try their hand at ice fishing in winter.
stops.english: Where the “Segl-Maria” sails across Lake Sils in the warmer months, anglers try their hand at ice fishing in winter.

stops.name: Bever
stops.quote: In Bever and Zuoz, the sgraffiti-decorated facades are delightful, and in Samedan, you can look forward to the mineral baths & spa.
stops.english: In Bever and Zuoz, the sgraffiti-decorated facades are delightful, and in Samedan, you can look forward to the mineral baths & spa.

stops.name: Val Bever
stops.quote: The Engadin is the ideal starting point for top excursions: experience the fairytale Val Bever, the Lower Engadin with the villages of Guarda and Scuol, or the Bernina Pass with Lago Bianco and Lago Nero.
stops.english: The Engadin is the ideal starting point for top excursions: experience the fairytale Val Bever, the Lower Engadin with the villages of Guarda and Scuol, or the Bernina Pass with Lago Bianco and Lago Nero.

stops.name: Zernez
stops.quote: At the other end of the valley is Zernez, gateway to the wilderness of the national park.
stops.english: At the other end of the valley is Zernez, gateway to the wilderness of the national park.
